MastersOfManoeuvre.description: Friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Character">characters</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks until the start of their next turn if they have traversed {[tilesTraversed]} or more hexes during their turn or end their turn next to a friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>.
